archetype: 5 (Jewel & Luxury with highly saturated, vibrant tones)
instructions_to_main_agent: REPLACE existing CSS color variables in index.css with the hyper-vibrant Jewel Tones provided below. The user specifically demanded 'jaw-dropping, vibrant, dynamic colors' because the original olive/brown/terracotta palette was too dull.

UPDATE the font from 'Cormorant Garamond' to 'Playfair Display' for all headings to evoke high-end luxury. Add the Google Font import: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap');

HERO SECTION: Use max overlay opacity bg-black/40 (do not make it too dark). Ensure the 'Penzión Kastelán' text has a jaw-dropping vibrant gradient (e.g., bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FFB703] via-[#FF9F1C] to-[#E63946]). Add a glowing drop-shadow.
BUTTONS: Replace standard buttons with vibrant gradient CTAs (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FFB703] to-[#E63946]) and apply the pulse animation. They must POP.
DARK SECTIONS: For 'Activities' and 'Reviews', use the deeply saturated '--color-dark-bg' (#081C15) instead of the dull brown-green. Use bright gold (#FFB703) for icons/accents on dark backgrounds.
BORDERS & SHADOWS: Use high-saturation tinted shadows instead of gray shadows (e.g., shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(6,95,70,0.15)]).
Replace ALL placeholder or stock images in App.js with the provided highly saturated image URLs. Do NOT use placeholder text for images.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are retained and added to any new interactive elements.

fonts.typesetting_rules: Tight tracking (tracking-tight) on H1 and H2. Leading-none for large text.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Increase paddings to p-12 or p-16 for sections.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use Mode A (Tetris Grid) for 'About' and 'Exterior' image galleries. Asymmetrical, overlapping images with heavy shadows.

components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-white/80, backdrop-blur-2xl, backdrop-saturate-150, border-b border-[#065F46]/10.
components.cards: Flat background with 1px border-[#065F46]/10, and a soft tinted hover shadow.
components.service_icons: Vibrant emerald or gold gradient backgrounds with contrasting icons.
